evidence.quote: Evaluation of generation's stability indicated that different truncations of the same sequence were more prone to yield similar annotations

biology_dependence_tests.result_summary: The paper reports similar annotations across sequence truncations but does not report performance relative to an untruncated-input condition.

coverage_notes: No separate biological encoder or connector is described; nucleotide sequences and annotations are tokenized and processed through the language-model input pathway. No explicit biological-input removal, mismatched/shuffled-input, random/noise-input, or no-biology text-only baseline test is reported. The exact LLaMA checkpoint initialization and whether the vocabulary was extended are unspecified. The paper reports truncation stability but not a direct normal-input performance comparison.

evidence.quote: We consider exact matches as correct after applying a vocabulary mapping that converts model-predicted vocab to informal names and abbreviations.

A total of 10 indexes are applied for the evaluation including precision, recall, F1 score, accuracy, false positive rate (FPR), true positive rate (TPR), false negative rate (FNR), true negative rate (TNR) and Matthew's correlation coefficient (MCC).

evaluation_formats.task: Closed-set classification of taxonomy, genomic element, enzyme, and nucleotide-sequence tasks evaluated with exact match and classification metrics

evidence.quote: The similarity was evaluated as the cosine similarity between the token embedding of the sequences.
The reproducibility is quantified as the mean cosine similarity among the token embeddings of the 10 repeats.

evaluation_formats.task: Generated nucleotide sequences and text annotations evaluated with automatic similarity, F1, diversity, reproducibility, and stability metrics

evaluation_formats.task: Mutation-effect prediction scored from log-likelihood differences

evidence.quote: We established OmniNA model with the LLaMA architecture 10 , which is an auto-regressive decoder-only transformer adopted the self-attention mechanism.
We construct three models with varying heads and layers, which range from 66 M up to 1.7 B
In the fine-tuning stage, only the answer was trained in an auto-regressive manner.
The reproducibility of model-generated text annotation is quantified as the similarity among the different repeats of the model generations.
We also evaluate the fidelity of the sequence generation as the similarity between the generated sequence and the ground truth sequence.
After fine-tuning, the model can manage taxonomy and genomic element identification tasks in a Question-Answer (QA) paradigm ( Figure 1A ).
We defined the effect score of a mutation as the OmniNA-1.7B estimated LL between mutated and wild-type nucleotide sequences
We design the prompts to organize the sequence data with the text annotations as feature-ordered input for model pre-training
By doing so, the model gains the capacity to understand semantic of text annotations, thereby empowering it to perform a wide range of downstream tasks.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors organize nucleotide sequences with textual annotations so the model can learn annotation semantics and support many downstream tasks.

evidence.quote: The flexibility of large-language models in accommodating various tasks in a QA manner enables a broader range of users, including those with less specialized expertise in deep learning, to harness the power of advanced language models for diverse applications 40 .

representation_rationale.summary: The QA formulation is presented as flexible for handling diverse tasks and accessible to broader users.

evidence.quote: However, these deep learning approaches are tailored to specific genome tasks, and thus have limited generalization ability to other tasks.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors contrast OmniNA with task-specific genomic models that have limited generalization across tasks.

evidence.quote: OmniNA is currently limited to learning sequences of approximately 3000 bps. Sequences exceeding this length require truncation for effective learning.

representation_rationale.summary: The sequence representation is limited to approximately 3000 base pairs, requiring longer sequences to be truncated.
